verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents agent access over MCP using OAuth 2.1 instead of API keys (docs-7). It also offers roles that scope access down to the table and column (docs-24), and agents can be confined to isolated, read-only compute (docs-12). Together these support least-privilege agent access, but the docs never explicitly describe issuing a scoped credential to a specific agent. missing for 10: explicit docs on issuing per-agent scoped tokens or credentials, evidence that OAuth grants or roles can be restricted per agent (e.g., read-only or table-limited scopes), credential lifecycle (expiry/revocation), independent or hands-on corroboration
